title: Remove local model fallbacks from CTO agent

change.reason: CTO cron and secondary sessions are falling back to qwen3.5:4B which cannot handle tool-using tasks — thinking blocks truncate mid-generation (stopReason: length), producing no usable output. Multiple sessions confirmed failing on local model. Primary model glm-5.2:cloud is stable (7+ day heartbeat streak). Removing local fallbacks ensures all CTO sessions use the cloud model exclusively.

riskAssessment: Low risk. Primary model glm-5.2:cloud has been stable for 7+ consecutive days. If cloud model goes down, CTO sessions will fail instead of falling back to an already-failing local model — net effect is the same (no working fallback either way). The current fallbacks are not providing value, only causing stuck sessions.
backupPlan: If glm-5.2:cloud becomes unavailable, fallbacks can be re-added. Original values documented here.
